CheckTitle: Security Groups with Telnet port (23) open to the internet
Description: Security Groups have been found to allow access from the internet to Telnet port.
Risk: Telnet (port 23) transmits all communication in plaintext, making credentials and commands easily sniffed for immediate server takeover.

Recommendation.Text: Make sure security groups do not allow any access from the internet to ports, unless required as per business requirements.
